  [░░░░░░░░░░] 0.0/10

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1. DoS POLICY CONFIGURATION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  DoS policies found: 0

  Findings:
  🔴 [CRITICAL] DoS Policies: NO DoS policies configured — FortiGate has zero flood/anomaly protection. Any flood attack hits the kernel directly. Configure 'config firewall DoS-policy' on all WAN interfaces immediately.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  2. IPS DoS ANOMALY PROTECTION
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IPS sensors found: 1
  Accept policies with IPS: 0 / 3

  Findings:
  🟡 [MEDIUM] IPS DoS: 3 accept policy/policies have no IPS sensor attached — DoS signature protection absent on these flows.
  🟡 [MEDIUM] IPS Sensor 'default-ips': botnet scanning in monitor mode — C2 connections are logged but not blocked. Change to 'block'.
  🟡 [MEDIUM] IPS Sensor 'default-ips': block-malicious-url disabled — known C2/malware URLs not blocked at IPS layer.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  3. RELATED HARDENING
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|                Current DoS-Related Settings               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+
| tcp-halfopen-timer     |                                  |
| tcp-timewait-timer     |                                  |
| anti-replay            |                                  |
| block-session-timer    |                                  |
| ip-src-check-on-tx     |                                  |
| resource-limit config  | False                            |
| NP DoS offload         | not detected                     |
| Local-in policies      | 1                                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------+

  Findings:
  🔵 [INFO] TCP Hardening: tcp-halfopen-timer not explicitly set — default may be too permissive.
  🟡 [MEDIUM] TCP Hardening: anti-replay is not set to 'strict' — packet replay attacks possible at the global level. CLI: config system global → set anti-replay strict
  🔵 [INFO] TCP Hardening: ip-src-check-on-tx not enabled — spoofed source IP packets may not be dropped on transmit. CLI: config system global → set ip-src-check-on-tx enable
  🟡 [MEDIUM] Resource Limits: 'config system resource-limit' not configured — no per-user or global session count ceilings. Under a flood attack, the session table can be exhausted. CLI: config system resource-limit → set type ipsec → set max-user-limit 1000
  🔵 [INFO] NP Offload: no NP7/NP6 DoS offload config detected — either this platform has no NP ASIC or offload is unconfigured. On NP-capable hardware, DoS offload dramatically reduces CPU impact.
  🟠 [HIGH] Mgmt Exposure: HTTPS management on WAN interface 'wan1' — management plane directly reachable from internet; restrict with local-in-policy or remove from allowaccess. CLI: config system interface → edit wan1 → set allowaccess (remove https)
  🟠 [HIGH] Mgmt Exposure: SSH on WAN interface 'wan1' — brute-force target; restrict via local-in-policy to admin IPs only.
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Mgmt Exposure: HTTP management on WAN interface 'wan1' — cleartext management on internet-facing interface is critical risk.
  🟡 [MEDIUM] Mgmt Exposure: ICMP/ping enabled on WAN interface 'wan1' — aids attacker reconnaissance and is an ICMP flood target. CLI: config system interface → edit wan1 → unset allowaccess ping
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Mgmt Exposure: SNMP on WAN interface 'wan1' — community string exposed to internet; immediate risk.
  🔴 [CRITICAL] Mgmt Exposure: Telnet on WAN interface 'wan1' — cleartext, remove immediately.
  🟠 [HIGH] Local-in: no local-in-policies configured on WAN interfaces — FortiGate control plane (management, VPN, BGP, etc.) has no explicit source restriction. An attacker can target these services directly. CLI: config firewall local-in-policy → edit 1 → set intf wan1 → set srcaddr <admin-ip-range> → set action accept
  🟡 [MEDIUM] Policy Exposure: 3 accept policy/policies with source 'all' and no IPS sensor — these policies have no rate-limiting layer; pair with a DoS policy on the same inbound interface.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  4. OVERALL ASSESSMENT & RECOMMENDATIONS
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  🔴 CRITICAL ISSUES (fix immediately):
    • DoS Policies: NO DoS policies configured — FortiGate has zero flood/anomaly protection. Any flood attack hits the kernel directly. Configure 'config firewall DoS-policy' on all WAN interfaces immediately.
    • Mgmt Exposure: HTTP management on WAN interface 'wan1' — cleartext management on internet-facing interface is critical risk.
    • Mgmt Exposure: SNMP on WAN interface 'wan1' — community string exposed to internet; immediate risk.
    • Mgmt Exposure: Telnet on WAN interface 'wan1' — cleartext, remove immediately.

  🟠 HIGH RISK ISSUES:
    • Mgmt Exposure: HTTPS management on WAN interface 'wan1' — management plane directly reachable from internet; restrict with local-in-policy or remove from allowaccess. CLI: config system interface → edit wan1 → set allowaccess (remove https)
    • Mgmt Exposure: SSH on WAN interface 'wan1' — brute-force target; restrict via local-in-policy to admin IPs only.
    • Local-in: no local-in-policies configured on WAN interfaces — FortiGate control plane (management, VPN, BGP, etc.) has no explicit source restriction. An attacker can target these services directly. CLI: config firewall local-in-policy → edit 1 → set intf wan1 → set srcaddr <admin-ip-range> → set action accept

  📋 RECOMMENDATIONS:

  ▸ 1. Create DoS policies on ALL WAN interfaces
      config firewall DoS-policy
          edit 1
              set interface wan1
              set srcaddr all
              set dstaddr all
              set status enable
              config anomaly
                  edit tcp_syn_flood
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 2000
                  next
                  edit udp_flood
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 2000
                  next
                  edit icmp_flood
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 250
                  next
                  edit ip_src_session
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 5000
                  next
                  edit tcp_port_scan
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 1000
                  next
                  edit ip_land_attack
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 1
                  next
                  edit ip_bad_option
                      set status enable
                      set log enable
                      set action block
                      set threshold 1
                  next
              end
          next
      end

  ▸ 2. Harden TCP timers
      config system global
          set tcp-halfopen-timer 10
          set tcp-timewait-timer 1
          set anti-replay strict
          set block-session-timer 30
          set ip-src-check-on-tx enable
      end

  ▸ 3. Restrict management access with local-in-policy
      config firewall local-in-policy
          edit 1
              set intf wan1
              set srcaddr <admin-mgmt-subnet>
              set dstaddr all
              set service HTTPS SSH
              set action accept
              set schedule always
          next
          edit 2
              set intf wan1
              set srcaddr all
              set dstaddr all
              set service ALL
              set action deny
              set schedule always
          next
      end

  ▸ 4. Configure NP hardware DoS offload (NP6/NP7 platforms)
      config system np7
          config hpe
              set enable-shaper enable
              set tcpsyn-max 10000
              set udp-max 10000
              set icmp-max 1000
              set sctp-max 10000
          end
          set fp-anomaly enable
      end
